login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your email and password to sign in
login.useOtp: Sign in with an email code

otp.title: Email sign-in
otp.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a 6-digit code — a new address creates an account
otp.sent: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otp.codeHint: 6 digits — check your spam folder if it hasn't arrived.
otp.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Sign up with your email
register.name: Display name
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a one-time reset link
forgot.sent: If that email is registered, a reset link is on its way (valid for 1 hour).

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account
reset.success: Password updated. Please sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is invalid or incomplete.

today.title: Daily speaking
today.durationHint: Speak for {min}-{max} seconds: your view, plus a reason and an example.
today.simplifiedScoring: Speech scoring was busy, so this one used the simplified check. The next step still holds, and today still counts.
today.nothingRecorded: No audio was captured. Check your microphone and try again.
today.micDenied: A microphone is needed to practise. Allow access and tap record again.

winner.A: Let's make it easier to hear
winner.B: Say it in your own words

coach.A: {count, plural, one {One word} other {# words}} came out unclear. Read them once more, then say your answer again.
coach.B: You leaned on the same few words the whole way through. Take this line as a model and go again.
coach.C_reason: You gave your view but not the reason behind it. Add one sentence and you're done.
coach.C_example: You have a view and a reason. One concrete example and you're done.
coach.C_more: Clear, with a reason and an example. One more concrete detail and you're done.

today.recorderUnavailable: This browser could not start recording. Try reloading, or use a different browser.

warmup.title: Warm up first (optional)
warmup.hint: Listen once, then read the line out loud. It is not scored.
warmup.recordingHint: Read the line above once. A couple of seconds is enough.
warmup.received: Warm-up done. Ready when you are.

degraded.title: This is taking longer than usual
degraded.message: The connection looks slow. You can keep waiting — your answer is still being scored — or finish here. Either way today counts.

failed.hint: Today's question is still here and today still counts. Record your answer again.

retry.hint: Take the note above and say it once more. A few seconds is enough.

done.title: That's today's practice done
done.seeWeek: See how this week has gone

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.validationFailed: Some fields are invalid. Please check and retry.
errors.accountDisabled: This account has been disabled. Contact an administrator.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.invalidToken: That link or code is invalid or has expired.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: Password must be at most 128 characters.
errors.passwordTooWeak: Password must contain both letters and numbers.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.audioNotWav: That recording could not be read. Please record again.
errors.audioWrongFormat: That recording is in an unsupported format. Please record again.
errors.audioTooShort: That was too short. Speak for at least 30 seconds.
errors.audioTooLong: That was too long. Keep it under 90 seconds.
errors.sessionNotScored: This practice has not been scored yet. Record your answer first.

me.title: Your week
me.empty: Practise a few days and a line about your progress will appear here.

progress.A: This week you have mostly been working on being easier to hear ({count} of the last {days} days).
progress.B: This week you have mostly been working on saying things in your own words ({count} of the last {days} days).
progress.C: This week you have mostly been working on finishing the thought ({count} of the last {days} days).
